purpose: Document distinct English/local-language search evidence, first-party local custody scope, direct anonymous route results and geometry-only limits.
assessment: Nagaland DLRS hosts a public digital cadastral map and identifies Dimapur land-record staff. The anonymous landing page is accessible, but the map flow is selector-driven and its script references credentials-enabled API requests plus survey personnel/plot records. No selectors or property records were queried.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official directorate page identifies the government land-record/survey custodian.

Anonymous public digital cadastral-map application is titled “An Interactive Digital Cadastre on a Map.” Static bundle advertises an external basemap and an API for district/subdivision/area/locality selectors; no geometry schema is exposed in inspected code. It also contains survey/staff table fields and withCredentials requests, so no selector/API call or plot query was made.
Official directory lists DLRS and Dimapur Municipal Council; district office evidence is local administrative, not point-specific parcel geometry.
